authorized: deterministic reproduction-for-instrumentation only (no saved weight checkpoints exist)
instrumentation_commit: <this branch HEAD; recorded per-run in reproduction_results.json via snapshot hashes>

snapshot_mechanism.how: torch.optim.AdamW.step is wrapped ONLY to count optimizer steps; the frozen record() entry points (diagnostics.routing_diagnostics for slot arms, stabilize._needle_at for every arm) are wrapped to deepcopy the live model at the checkpoint boundary
why_it_does_not_alter_training: deepcopy consumes no torch global RNG and touches no optimizer state
the snapshot is taken at the TOP of a checkpoint iteration (before that iteration's optimizer step), exactly where the committed record(step) runs
transient grad-attached capture attrs (_sfs_wlogit/_sfs_rlogit) are nulled before deepcopy; they are never read by the training forward/loss and are recomputed on demand
training reproduction always uses the STOCK frozen forward; the instrumented forward is bound only to frozen snapshots

reproduction_gate.determinism_control_proof: A+ seed 25 reproduced byte-identically (needle_by_dist and ppl exact; trajectory exact at every common checkpoint) prior to any failure-exemplar reproduction

threads_note: torch.set_num_threads(4) preserved from the frozen runner; changing thread count would change fp32 reduction order and break byte-identity, so reproduction is sequential
